chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from Zurārah and al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Concerning a man and a woman, how the salat is performed over them, he said: the woman is placed behind the man, and the man is to be in the position nearest to the Imam.

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the male deceased in this ruling
key_terms.الْإِمَامَ: the prayer leader conducting the funeral salat
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the female deceased in this ruling
key_terms.يَلِي: is nearest to or adjacent to

ai.seo_question: How should a man and a woman be arranged in funeral salat when prayed over together?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the arrangement of a male and female deceased when the funeral salat is performed over them together. It states that the woman is placed behind the man, while the man is positioned closest to the Imam leading the prayer.
